summary: All 5 story-first sections, sticky Week/Position/Coverage/Game filter bar, Story Mode, swappable receivers.json, committed generator, and README are present; npm install + npm run build pass clean (exit 0) and a dev smoke check renders every section with no runtime/hydration errors.

findings.detail: Model coefficient mismatch: src/lib/toe.ts defaultModel (a=0.085037, b=0.067407) and the README JSONC example do not match the committed receivers.json expectationModel (a=0.085198, b=0.068413). The Headline scatter passes the file's own expectationModel into expectedTargetShareLine, so the rendered reference line is correct and defaultModel is only a fallback; still, sync defaultModel and the README example to the real a/b so the documented/mirrored values are accurate.

README's receivers.json shape comment and expectationModel.formula read 'clamp(a + b*openRate, 0, 1)', while the committed real file's per-row expectedTargetShare is a route-participation baseline (routesRun/teamRoutes) stored on each row. The README's 'where a/b live' section does clarify a/b are only for the scatter reference line, but the top-level formula string is misleading on its own; consider aligning the formula text with the route-participation baseline note.
